_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: how far the hour hand turns, or a time difference added; 2: the angle at a half hour or a time that needs one formula, or a mirror time; 3: an angle at any time, a reflex or smaller angle, or a clock that gains; 4: a time when the hands meet or are opposite, or how often that happens. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
